note: UK to Orlando (MCO) return economy, GBP, for a family of 4 (2 adults + 2 children) - scale linearly by party size if different, noted in the UI. These matter here specifically because school holidays force travel into the highest-demand windows - there's no 'cheap May' option for this family. Includes UK Air Passenger Duty (~£408 for 2 adults return from April 2026, under-16s exempt in economy).

low.example: Feb half-term / Easter, booked well ahead

peak.example: Peak summer (Jul-Aug), also assume similar for Christmas
